newsitem.title: FRANCE: Iraq set Dec 17 deadline for French wheat bids.
newsitem.headline: Iraq set Dec 17 deadline for French wheat bids.

text.p: Exporters taking part in an Iraqi tender to buy French wheat have until December 17 to submit their offers to sell, French grain exporters said on Friday.
Iraq has indicated that it would make a decision on the tender by December 19, they said.
Paris grain traders said on Thursday Iraq had launched a tender to import 100,000 tonnes of French wheat during January and February.
Iraq is seeking French wheat with a protein content of 11 percent.
Payment will be made through funds held in an escrow account managed by the New York-based branch of Banque Nationale de Paris, traders said.
News of the tender came as Iraq prepares to sell limited quantities of oil under a United Nations-approved plan to raise cash to purchase food and medicine.
Exporters estimate that Iraq may eventually buy up to one million tonnes of wheat to meet its needs for two million tonnes of commodities. --Paris newsroom +331 4221 5432
